title: A Lot of Buns
lines: Sal has a lot of buns in a tub.
A cat hops up. It naps in the tub!
The legs of the cat are in the buns.
"A lid can be on top," said Sal.
She has the lid. The lid is on the tub.
The cat taps at the lid.
"Let the cat sit on top," said Mom.
The cat naps on the lid on a bed.
scoring_note: Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
